commits.message:
fix(traceback): survive throwing reads, keep an error's name, read node's coded header (rich-traceback-9vcb)

High-review fixes: a value whose name/message/stack read throws is reported
under NonError where Pretty marks the throw, instead of throwing out of the
crash handler; a non-string message is formatted by Pretty under the error's
own name; node's `Name [ERR_X]: message` header comes off whole; a stale
header with no V8 frame shows no frame; a NonError value is laid out in the
width left after its name.

fix(traceback): render any caught value and every V8 frame shape (rich-traceback-9vcb)

Traceback takes unknown and reads a caught value by shape in browser-safe
code (string name + message is an error; anything else is NonError,
formatted by Pretty), replacing installTraceback's node:util toError.

Frames: the stack's own header is stripped before frames are read, so a
message line is never a frame; frames with no line (Promise.all index,
<anonymous>, native) keep their location; eval frames show the eval
site's file; SpiderMonkey/JSC stacks are read; an unreadable line shows
verbatim. The data bounds print uses move to pretty.ts as
UNSEEN_DATA_BOUNDS so Traceback shares them.

fix(live): plain output on a non-interactive console (rich-live-9rdn) (#292)

* fix(live): a Live on a non-interactive console writes plain lines and its frame once at stop (rich-live-9rdn)

A Live over a console that is not interactive painted every refresh, and
each print through live.console carried an erase and a full repaint — the
bytes CI logs and pipes received. It now holds a FinalFramePainter there:
nothing while frames change, printed text as given, the last frame once at
hand-back, as Rich's Live does.

Painter becomes the interface both painters satisfy; the terminal one is
SurfacePainter, which App and an interactive Live hold. Reset-before-show
already had one owner in its handBack; App's inline surface now pins it
too. Live's header records why it is not built on App.

* fix(live): off a terminal, Live draws one frame and prints it through the console (rich-live-9rdn)

High review on #292:
- Live, Progress and Status made their default console with forceTerminal,
  so piped output still painted every frame. They now take `new Console()`,
  which detects, as Rich's get_console() does.
- Console.isInteractive excludes TERM=dumb/unknown (Rich's is_interactive);
  `isDumbTerminal` is the one check colour detection also uses.
- Painter.paint/around take a FrameSource. FinalFramePainter keeps the last
  one and draws it only at handBack, so ticks and prints render nothing off
  a terminal and a throwing tick cannot write a stale "final" frame.
- The final frame is a console.print, so record and capture hold it.

Not changed: the final frame stays cropped to console height, and text
printed with end:"" runs into it — both as Rich's LiveRender does.

* fix(paint): around() draws the frame before it moves the row count (rich-live-9rdn)

Medium review on #292: with the frame drawn lazily, a render that threw
inside around() had already zeroed the rows, so the next paint drew under
the stale frame instead of over it.
